question: Which calendrical cycles should be used to structure the sequence of oblations?
premises: Oblations can be correlated with time cycles.
Weekdays beginning with the sun form one cycle.
Lunar mansions beginning with the horse form another cycle.
inference: Oblations should be performed in accordance with weekdays beginning with the sun and lunar mansions beginning with Aśvinī.
uncertainties: turagādibhiḥ is taken as Aśvinī and following nakṣatras
plain_english: One should do so with the weekdays beginning with Sunday and with the lunar mansions beginning with Aśvinī.
